questions.question: In which year was the club founded?
questions.explanation: 1878. The story began with young workers at George Salter’s spring factory.

questions.question: Who scored the winner in the 1968 FA Cup final?
questions.explanation: Jeff Astle. His extra-time goal beat Everton 1–0.

questions.question: What was Albion’s dramatic survival in 2005 called?
questions.explanation: The Great Escape. Albion stayed up after being bottom at Christmas.
